messages.content: User task: Summarize the most important points of today's news for me.

raw_response:
I don't have access to live news or the internet—I can only inspect files on your local machine. If you have news articles saved as text files somewhere, point me at the directory or files and I can summarize them.

PLAN: list_dir {"path": "/home/user/Downloads"}  # example; replace with your actual news folder
PLAN: read_file {"path": "/home/user/Downloads/latest-news.txt"}  # example; replace with actual file
